source_map.finding: HawkingNativeConfig is the profile-driven native execution contract; paths, protocol, runtime mode, capabilities, limits, and qualification metadata are data-owned.
Native profile/artifact selection is explicit and fail-closed; no implicit CPU backend token or model runtime is selected.
ResidentProcess owns the JSONL child lifecycle and HawkingNativeConnector owns translation, readiness, start/stop, and restart boundaries.
RuntimeBackend is the common contract; NoeticNativeBackend is the admitted native implementation and its aliases preserve the serialized backend identity.
Runtime factory dispatch admits noetic_native and rejects implicit MLX/GGUF/vendor selection; the canonical factory independently enforces the native boundary.
Stable native helper resolution is release-owned and fail-closed; source-checkout builds are not implicit permission owners.
The live native ladder is explicit and separates direct resident, connector, and provider-abstraction stages; it is not hardware qualification by itself.
